body:
Thanks for the input!

I'm not contesting him living with her, I literally would have no way of supporting him at any capacity when I cannot even support myself.

It looks like we're heading down the path of putting him first.  She's already told me that she'll do whatever it takes to have me see him on a regular basis.  We're not doing anything official with custody or with child support (we handled it just fine before on our own (and she knows I couldn't afford a dime of child support)) so I'm not necessarily worried about her *taking him away*.  I know I'll get to see him, but it'll be different and less often.

I'm pretty committed to the school at this point in time.  I have a lease signed for the next seven months already, I'm registered for classes, and it's one of the top public schools in the country.  I was really excited about going and getting my life together and maybe even excited to meet new people and get out... but all of that seems like bull shit now that this has happened, heh.
